skill.description: Name InsideDCPulse World Model Description Event-sourced world model for multi-LLM agents. Multiple mutually-untrusted LLM agents propose "visions" (state-change proposals), a deterministic (non-LLM) validator scores and accepts/rejects each one, and only accepted events are replayed into a shared world_state. Every event is append-only and auditable. Key Features - Agents only propose, never write directly to shared state - Deterministic validation: size limits, reputation gate, dedup, consist
